title: The Man Hidden Beneath Doom’s Castle
description: Part 2 of an original spoiler recap and commentary about Marvel Comics Secret Wars (2015), written by Jonathan Hickman and drawn by Esad Ribic. Comics canon, not a prediction of the MCU films.
hook: Doctor Doom's godlike power came from a man hidden beneath his castle.
payoff: That man now owed him a favor. All for one hamburger.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Doctor Doom's godlike power came from a man hidden beneath his castle.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: A GOD WITH A SECRET

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Spider-Man Miles Morales found him while the survivors investigated Doom's power.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: MILES FINDS THE SOURCE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: This was Molecule Man. His cosmic power was keeping Doom on the throne.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: MOLECULE MAN → DOOM

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The cosmic power source was hungry. Miles happened to have a hamburger.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: A HUNGRY COSMIC BEING

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He handed it over. A small kindness to someone with power over whole realities.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: ONE HAMBURGER

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Before this, Miles had lost his mother. Now he'd helped someone who could reshape realities.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: MILES HAD LOST HIS MOTHER

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: That man now owed him a favor. All for one hamburger.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: A COSMIC DEBT

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Next: Doom loses the throne—and we learn what that favor was worth.
units.visual_query: Original symbolic comic diagram: PART THREE · THE FAVOR
